method: Read-only retained version-pinned source and existing evidence. No native execution, syscall observation, VM or live account action. The stopped native-tracing path remains stopped.

findings.contract: auth status is not account adoption
findings.result: JSON/text status reads cached oauthAccount. Recent complete profiles may skip initialization for 24 hours; initialization is asynchronous. No ordinary force-refresh option or acknowledgment was established.

findings.contract: existing helper is not auth status
findings.result: The helper starts the normal safe-mode stream-json initialize control flow in a private config with no tools or MCP servers. Historical conditional auth-status artifacts do not prove that account profile was fetched.

Native login writes oauthAccount separately from credentials, may merge sparse profile fields, and clears additional local caches/waits. A config writer can fall back outside its acquired lock; file watching is not an atomic account/policy acknowledgment.

The identified noninteractive login path requires a refresh secret through environment, which does not meet the reviewed no-token-environment contract. No such exception or replacement operation is implemented.

operational_requirements: Native credential renewal without lost generation
Permission, question and quota wait behavior across adoption
cosmetic_non_requirement: A stale displayed label alone does not require universal internal cache equivalence.
independent_review: Astra: existing evidence cannot establish exclusive config publication in the presence of native fallback writers. Exact native profile capture would establish provenance, not writer exclusion or account/policy coherence. Atomic rename plus readback cannot exclude a later stale native write.

disposition.common_slot_publisher: DISABLED; no production bootstrap or publisher
disposition.native_file_candidate: UNQUALIFIED; requires supported writer exclusion or proven no-lost-generation protocol plus ordinary relevant outcome qualification
disposition.legacy_profile_behavior: May preserve healthy old incarnations and use selected identity for qualified new births; this is not seamless provider-wide convergence.
disposition.independent_implementation: Continue parked maintenance, Store custody/recovery and Codex integration behind their respective gates.

limits: Source leads are specific to the retained binary and are not a stable public provider API.
This is an explicit unresolved disposition, not a new native test or passing qualification.
No bypass, cache forcing, config copier, credential environment exception or tracing retry is authorized or implemented by this record.

sources.result: Official docs confirm a logged-out interactive sibling using the same config can adopt a new native login without restart. This narrower condition does not establish unattended saved-account publication or policy coherence.
Official multi-account guidance assigns separate configuration directories. It does not supply an automatic whole-provider switch operation.
The public auth command reference lists login, logout and status; no saved-login adoption acknowledgment is documented there.
